comment: The shop window, PLAN.md section 8. Before/after live is DATA, not code: while
app_store_url is null the card shows an honest 'In review at the App Store' tag and
links to the fallback. When an app goes live, one field changes and the card flips to
the official badge and the store URL. No template edit, no code path change, which is
what makes the flip verifiable by diffing two GETs of the live page.
Never imply an app is live before it is: the honest state is the default here.
